description: This file defines the CalculatorPanel React functional component, which composes multiple subcomponents such as Display, MemoryControls, Keypad, and TrigPad to form a calculator interface. It includes state management, event handling for calculator operations, keyboard accessibility, and styling with Tailwind CSS.

methods.name: CalculatorPanel
methods.description: Main React functional component for calculator panel, handling display, input, memory, trigonometric functions, and event handling.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles numeric and operator key presses for calculator operations.

methods.name: handleTrig
methods.description: Handles trigonometric function calculations (sin, cos, tan).

methods.name: handleMemoryAdd
methods.description: Adds current display value to memory.

methods.name: handleMemorySubtract
methods.description: Subtracts current display value from memory.

methods.name: handleMemoryRecall
methods.description: Recalls the memory value into display.

methods.name: keyboardHandler
methods.description: Handles global keyboard events to simulate calculator button presses.
